newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's unemployment down to 17.7 pct in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's unemployment down to 17.7 pct in Q1.

text.p: Morocco's unemployment dropped to 17.7 percent in the first quarter of 1997 from 19.4 percent in the same period last year, the Statistics Directorate said.
In its monthly newsletter received on Tuesday it said: "Employment in urban areas has improved during the first quarter leading to a drop in unemployment of graduates."
The number of employed people in Morocco's urban areas slightly declined to 4.74 million in the first quarter against 4.76 million in the same period in 1996, the directorate said.
Women represented 25.8 percent of the total compared with 27.8 percent in the same period last year, it said.
The state-run directorate gave no figures for the rural workforce which represents 50 percent of Morocco's total active population estimated at between 9.5 and 10 million.
